verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships official client libraries (rclcpp, rclpy, etc.) documented as first-party SDKs letting users write ROS 2 code in C++, Python, and other languages, with verified working APIs and CLI tooling built on top of them (ros2-docs-7, ros2-docs-19, ros2-docs-21, ros2-docs-35, ros2-docs-36, ros2-docs-17). Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation specifically of SDK quality/completeness and any AI-specific SDK extensions or release cadence details.
